question.text: For PMS, taxation typically occurs at the:

answer.text: Investor (client) level, since PMS is individually managed (pass-through at SEBI level)

explanation.text: The Logic: PMS is treated as investor-owned assets; each transaction affects the client's tax. The Trap: AIF tax treatment differs; PMS not taxed at PM level. Cross-Exam Context: Same in X-B. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Clients must file taxes on PMS transactions; share detailed capital-gain statements.
